name: save-boot-14c-item-screen-press
description: #135 (diagnostic, attempt 2): as 14a, but Circle is pressed every 60 frames until menu_ovl reads 1 (ovl_wait; 0 = it never did within 600 frames, and the script stops there), then 120 frames pass with no input. Reports the raw item_screen, list_row, list_off, party_row and ovl_addr. Checks: item_screen 1, list_row 0, list_off 0.

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; confirmed #76): field 1, menu 5.

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): the field ID.

loading.description: g_IsFieldLoading (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): 2 in a settled field.

row0.description: menuCursor (confirmed #78): the main-menu cursor, row 0 = Item.

item_screen.description: itemMenuScreen (confirmed, #135): g_ItemMenuCurrentScreen, an Item-menu overlay variable: 1 the item list, 2 picking a party member. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) config/symbols.itemmenu.us.txt, src/menu/itemmenu.c

list_row.description: itemListRow (confirmed, #135): g_ItemMenuWidgets[1] (0x801D3DDC + 0x12) + 0x0B row, the item list cursor on the page. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) include/game.h MenuTable

list_off.description: itemListOffset (confirmed, #135): g_ItemMenuWidgets[1] + 0x02 rowOffset, the slot on the top row. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code)

party_row.description: itemTargetSlot (confirmed, #135): g_ItemMenuWidgets[2] (0x801D3DDC + 0x24) + 0x0B row, the party cursor. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code)

menu_ovl.description: D_80062DD4 (hypothesis, #135 attempt 2): the menu overlay id SysMenuLoadMenuFileById last asked for; 1 = the Item screen (ITEMMENU_Init is entry 1 of the init table D_800493A8). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) src/main/1F6B4.c, src/main/ovl.c

menu_prev.description: D_80062DD0 (hypothesis): the overlay id before it. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) src/main/1F6B4.c

ovl_addr.description: D_80062DEC (hypothesis): the RAM address menu overlays are read to (0x801D0000 initially; a setter can change it). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) src/main/1F6B4.c LoadMenuOvl

hp1.description: partyHp1 (confirmed #101): g_ActiveCharacters[1].hp, the slot the item is used on.
